provenance.method: Complete non-absolute signs and exact rational multinomial sample ensemble; separate unit-ball feature and Gram quadratic checks; fixed-margin theorem penalties.

observed.scope: Fixed xorshift32 illustration; full independent sign enumeration conditional on these observations. Exact ideal i.i.d. ensemble is separate.

linear.scope: Separate fixed feature sample, not the three-input probability experiment. Unit Euclidean weight ball. Integer Gram and norm-square certificates use unscaled features; scale applies afterward. Population radius covers all eight declared domain features. The large-M curve is an additive theorem penalty, not a risk estimate or replication of this fixed sample.

data.scope: Non-absolute Rademacher average with normalization 1/m. Exact signs conditional on a fixed sample; ideal i.i.d. ensemble over rational multinomial counts; separate unit-ball feature experiment and fixed-margin theorem penalty. Neither one deterministic trace nor a large-M penalty scan is a high-probability empirical validation.
